R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. drip = trickle (flowing in drops). Vat, beaker, sawdust and skillet are clearly wrong.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. magnitude = size. Scalar, continuum, average and trillion are not synonyms. The gloss is correct.

R2's own note answers its fail: a till is a kind of drawer, which runs the wrong way. A drawer is not a kind of till, nor of folder, laptop or towel. A drawer is a container, and the gloss is the right general sense.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. erratic = unpredictable. Apathetic, unfriendly, listless and lethargic are clearly wrong. The gloss is correct.

stall = booth (a market stall) is sound. R1 is right that 'shop' (a small open-fronted shop) is defensible, so drop it. Bazaar, vendor and bakery remain. The gloss is the restaurant-booth sense, not the market stall, so hide it.
I agree with R1. 'ugly' is a common playground body insult, and appearance-judgement pairs are unsuitable for 8 to 15.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. somersault = flip. Swipe, downhill, squat and hurdle are clearly wrong. The gloss is correct.
horseman = rider is sound. Both rounds are right that 'cavalier' literally means a horseman, so drop it. Herder, reindeer and handler remain.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. inheritance = legacy (property passed on at death). Heir, eldest, spouse and beneficiary are people, not the thing inherited. The gloss is correct.

low -> high is the clean opposite, and lower, ascend, scarce and sink are not, so R1's pass holds on the link. But the gloss is the noun sense ('a lofty level', as in 'an all-time high'), not the adjective. Hide it.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. probability = likelihood. Decimal, statistic and minimum are clearly wrong. The gloss is correct.

I agree with both rounds. 'fastener' is a more natural answer for pin (R2's blind solver chose it). 'pinion' (to pin down) is also defensible, and 'knob' is vulgar slang. Dropping all three would leave one option.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. carve = sculpt. Gild, sunken and sculptor (a person) are clearly wrong. The gloss is correct.
R2's own note confirms the noun sense. equestrian = horseman (the same dictionary synset as the gloss). Handler, racer, judo and rocker are clearly wrong. Fine at level 5.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. argumentative = quarrelsome (given to quarreling). Humorless, moralistic, tactless and dogmatic are different traits.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. few = handful (a small number). Thirty, forty and fifty are specific numbers, and minute means tiny in size, not in number.
I agree with both rounds. 'gestation' is adult and obscure at level 4, and a cluster of pregnancy and puberty words is unsuitable distractor material for this age band.
craftsman = artisan is exact. Both rounds are right that 'bartender' is an alcohol-service word, so drop it. Carpenter, engraver and mason are specific crafts, not synonyms.
I agree with both rounds. Shellfish include crustaceans, not only mollusks, and many mollusks are not shellfish, so the link is false.
empty -> full is the clean level-1 opposite, and exit, stale, plentiful and entrance are not. R1 is right that the gloss is the full-moon sense, so hide it.

R2's obscurity point decides it. 'flounce' as a dress trim is obscure even at level 7: children know the word only as 'to storm off', and the distractors are all garment words. Doubtful, so it does not ship.

fuzzy = downy (covered with fine soft hair) is sound. Both rounds are right that 'velvety' is defensible, so drop it, along with 'matt' (an odd variant spelling that reads like a name). Lacy and down remain.
I agree with both rounds. archil/orchil is two spellings of a lichen dye, far too obscure for any child, and 'aal' is too.

R1's worry does not hold. 'fitness' meaning suitability ('fitness for the job') is the word's primary dictionary sense, and the gloss teaches it. Evaluation, assessment, examiner and specification are clearly wrong, so fitness is the only defensible answer.
I agree with both rounds. A cocoon (a silk case) is not a chrysalis (a butterfly pupa), 'sucker' is an insult, and 'anopheles' is obscure.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. scribble = scrawl (poor handwriting). Memo, notebook, jog and shuffle are clearly wrong.
I agree with both rounds. A sabot is a wooden clog, so 'clog' is equally defensible, and 'sabot' is obscure at level 5.

R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. fondness = liking ('a liking for sweets'). Jealousy, derision and animosity run the other way, and acceptance is different. The gloss is close enough to the shared sense.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. platter = tray (a flat serving receptacle), as thesauruses list. Taco, cornbread, bag and truffle are clearly wrong. The gloss is correct.
I agree with both rounds. Most acacias are trees and 'tree' is not offered, so 'shrub' is not clearly the category.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. intellect = mind (the seat of reason). Aptitude, empathy, mindful (an adjective) and acuity (sharpness) are not synonyms. The gloss is correct.
I agree with both rounds. Spice is one kind of flavoring, and 'sweetener' is also a flavoring, so there is no exact synonym.
I agree with R1. Body-part distractors (eyesight, retinal, pituitary) beside 'abnormality'/'defect' frame bodies as defective, which stigmatises disability. abnormality is also not exactly 'defect'.
rogue = scoundrel is sound, and the gloss shows it. Both rounds are right that 'swindler' is defensible and 'murder' is a grim filler word, so drop both. Felon and treachery remain.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. twelve = dozen. Six, twenty, nine and fifteen are other numbers. The gloss is correct.
I agree with both rounds. An essay is not an article (a school essay is not a published piece). A loose synonym at level 1.

I agree with both rounds. 'thong' has an underwear meaning and 'pinion' is defensible. Dropping both leaves 'padlock' and 'bridle', and bridle (to restrain, curb) is itself arguable for the verb shackle, so it cannot be fixed cleanly.

I agree with both rounds. 'hell' and 'damnation' are swear words and faith terms. Dropping them leaves 'adversary' and 'cruelty', and cruelty is arguable as a near-synonym of evil, so it cannot be fixed.
I agree with both rounds. A child's allowance (pocket money) is not a grant. A weak, confusing synonym.
contempt = disdain (the gloss is their shared definition) is sound. Both rounds are right that 'derision' (scorn) is defensible, so drop it. Insult, acceptance and affront remain.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. cheap -> expensive is a clean opposite. Trendy, sell, export and import are not. The gloss is correct.

R2's 'loose' does not sink it. A silo is a farm tower for storing grain, and a granary is a storehouse for grain, so they are near-exact synonyms. Chowder, barley and maize are foods, and a pantry is a household food cupboard. The gloss is correct.
I agree with both rounds. 'arnica' and the distractors (buckthorn, capparis, artemisia) are too obscure, and arnica is better called an herb or a plant.
guidance = advice is sound. Both rounds are right that 'supervision' and 'assistance' are defensible, so drop both. Tutor and mentor remain, and both are people, not advice.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. opponent = rival. Boxer, puck, tennis and champion are clearly wrong. The gloss is correct.
I agree with both rounds. 'shrink' as slang for psychiatrist mocks mental-health care, and 'recoil' is defensible (shrink back).
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. verification = confirmation (proof that something is correct). Testimony, authenticity, perjury and validity are not synonyms. The gloss is correct.
viewpoint = perspective is exact. Both rounds are right that 'racism' and 'atheism' are loaded filler words (race, faith), so drop both. Tenet and humanism remain.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. closing = shutting. Zipper, gap, takeoff and reset are clearly wrong. The gloss is correct.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. legacy = inheritance. Claimant, eyewitness and landowner are people, not the thing inherited. The gloss is correct.
I agree with both rounds. 'chute' primarily means a slide or channel. As 'parachute' it is an informal clipping that confuses a child.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. exhale -> exhalation is an exact verb-to-noun family pair. Yawn, turbulence, dizziness and recoil are other roots.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. mixing = blending. Batch, ingredient and mixture (the result, not the act) are not synonyms. The gloss is correct.
I agree with both rounds. A ski is not a kind of metal. The link is false.

R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. contentment = fulfillment (satisfaction), as thesauruses list. Elation is a different emotion, discontent the opposite, and acceptance and indignation are not synonyms.

R2's 'noun->adj' concern is about the internal pattern label, not the content. The shown link is 'Word families', and blackish is in black's family. Brownish, tawny, reddish and khaki are other colour roots. Neutral colour words, and the gloss is correct.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. necktie = tie. Headband, doublet, bodice and overcoat are other garments. The gloss is correct.
R2's fail gives only the link name and no defect. saltwater = seawater (the same synset in the dictionary, as the gloss shows). Spawn, bream, eel and catfish are clearly wrong.
